description: This file defines the CampaignsController class which extends the SugarController class. It handles HTTP request actions related to campaigns, specifically providing a newsletterlist view and processing actions such as editing views and wizard navigation.

classes.name: CampaignsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing campaign-related actions in SuiteCRM, including displaying newsletter lists and handling edit/view workflows.

methods.name: action_newsletterlist
methods.description: Sets the view to display the newsletter list.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles different action cases for editing views and transitions to wizard home, then calls parent process method.
